approach: Independent single-threaded sparse logistic baseline: hashed categorical/entity tokens, normalized numeric and calendar features, and leave-one-out smoothed entity history for training. It caps training rows, source columns, and hash dimensionality to remain below the memory budget while preserving prediction-row order.
command: python solution.py --task-dir PATH --time-col NAME --entity-col NAME --target-col NAME --split val|test --out FILE
